shape: 3-portal H-arena (S + W + E gates) with center bridge and east clique
description: Three-portal arena split into west, center, and east halves. WEST CHAIN: spawn_west → rt4364 (west entry, 3-way) → y8dp9d (south entry hub) connects to south_gate plus a NW loop (ad7t77 + pv8w9o). CENTER: 3mu5x1 + drqiwr (south side) link to rt4364 and pv8w9o (forming a small clique). EAST CHAIN: tqeb91 → dqoid5 (east hub) → bf7d2j (east entry, joins spawn_east) + gfmmym + bx3508 → ahij18 → xri71f (SE pocket chain).

portals.south: spawn_south at (-14.41, 23.80) — gate on the south (high-Z) side, west column
portals.west: spawn_west at (-21.61, -0.60) — gate on the west (low-X) side
portals.east: spawn_east at (23.93, 6.37) — gate on the east (high-X) side

traversalNotes: Direct S→E: spawn_south → south_inner → west_inner → center → e_step → east_hub → east_inner → spawn_east. 7 hops.
Direct S→W: spawn_south → south_inner → west_inner → spawn_west. 3 hops.
Direct W→E: spawn_west → west_inner → center → e_step → east_hub → east_inner → spawn_east. 6 hops.
NW LOOP: south_inner + c_loop_a + c_loop_b + west_inner form a square; BFS picks the shorter side.
SE pocket chain (se_step → se_pocket_a → se_pocket_b) is a 3-hop dead-end off east_hub.
ne_step is a 1-hop pocket off east_inner.
